title: LEMONADE: A Large Multilingual Expert-Annotated Abstractive Event Dataset for the Real World
reasoning: The paper introduces a multilingual dataset (LEMONADE) for abstractive event extraction and benchmarks various LLMs and specialized models on this task. While the dataset schema includes specific categories related to religious entities (e.g., 'Jewish Group', 'Muslim Group') and cultural/spiritual events (e.g., 'Accused of Witchcraft'), the research focus is on the technical accuracy of information extraction rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
